headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens To Miss Week 5
summary: The sprained ankle Lamar Jackson suffered in Week 4 will sideline the superstar quarterback for at least one game. The Ravens will not create any mystery about the two-time MVP’s status, ruling him out for their Week 5 matchup against the Falcons. headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
summary: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among Eagles ruled out vs. Jaguars
summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.

headline: 49ers DE Mykel Williams to make season debut vs. Seahawks
summary: 49ers defensive end Mykel Williams will make his 2026 debut Sunday against the Seahawks, a little less than a year after tearing his ACL and suffering meniscus damage in his right knee.

headline: Injuries to LT Tyler Guyton, WR CeeDee Lamb are not serious
summary: The X-rays on Cowboys left tackle Tyler Guyton's back were negative, coach Brian Schottenheimer said Friday.
